question: Is the registry row PB_C4 BlastDamage 180 bound to the C-4 projectile, or is the asset's own 100 the only linked value?

sourceFacts.method: The build's asset catalog (467208 routes) was searched for a file named PB_C4. The C-4 weapon file's imports were resolved by file GUID to its projectile. The imports of PNS_C4 and of six other projectile files into the gadget registry file were resolved to registry row names by object GUID.

control.description: PB_NS_RPG imports 7 registry rows and PB_M4SLAM_EFP 6, all under their own owner name, as L3316 found for assets with registry-backed values; the same resolver finds none for PNS_C4.

inference: No file named PB_C4 exists in the catalog, and nothing saved imports the PB_C4 registry rows. They are taken to be leftovers of a renamed or removed projectile.
WB_C4, the C-4 weapon, imports PNS_C4, which imports no registry row. Its own BlastDamage 100 is the only value linked to the weapon, and it gives EA's 350 against tanks (L3327).

Projectiles that import registry rows under their own name (RPG, SLAM EFP) are the ones where the registry can override; the M136 AT, MBT-LAW, SLAM body and C-4 import none, which agrees with their own values reproducing EA's figures.
unresolved: Not confirmed in game. Test: one C-4 pack on a full-health tank; 350 expected, 630 would mean the PB_C4 row is used after all.
Whether other registry owners are orphans in the same way was not surveyed.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: C-4: the registry row PB_C4 belongs to no file in the game catalog; the C-4 weapon imports PNS_C4
leads.summary: The game catalog has no file named PB_C4; the C-4 weapon WB_C4 imports the projectile PNS_C4, which imports no registry row. The registry rows under PB_C4 (BlastDamage 180) are bound to nothing saved, so the asset's own 100 stands, giving EA's 350 against tanks. 7 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: An in-game C-4 reading on a tank other than 350.
leads.statusNote: Settled from the catalog and stored imports; no in-game reading.
